correctness.rationale: For m>=3 the grounded Laplacian is an injective affine function of all individual edge weights and its logdet is strictly concave. Graph automorphisms force the unique unrestricted optimizer to have two edge classes. The exact spectrum is 0, 2d, mb (m-1 times), and 2a+(m-2)b (m-1 times). Matrix–Tree, budget substitution and a differentiated scalar objective give the sign-changing quadratic. Its unique nonnegative maximizer yields the threshold, exact conductances and both asymptotics. The embedded verifier passed 8 rational determinants, 175 direct determinants, 175 root/budget checks, 2100 asymmetric comparisons, 18 independent optimizations, 18 scaling tests; none of these finite checks is substituted for proof.
